time.expression: p^{1/3} exp(O(sqrt(log p log log p))) = p^{1/3+o(1)} expected time

notes: The source abstract claims a Las Vegas OneEnd algorithm analyzed without a smoothness heuristic, with the displayed expected time and memory. Known unconditional reductions transfer OneEnd to the supersingular endomorphism-ring and isogeny problems. This is a preprint claim checked against the primary arXiv abstract; the full proof was not independently audited. The p exponent remains exponential in log p and is not a concrete parameter-set break.

extra.model: Classical Las Vegas; expected time and memory
extra.reduction: OneEnd to EndRing and Isogeny; see also arXiv:2502.17010
